svg.title: Ustye: Backwater Crossing, 5 km design plan
svg.desc: Fictional coastal map. Riverside town on both banks of the central bridge, three crossings, woodland, depot, sawmill and proposed water tower observation deck. Design only.
svg.text: Fictional design | 5000 x 5000 m | 25 km2 | north = -Z | no verified LOS or gameplay
1 north crossing | 2 central bridge | 3 south crossing | 4 church | 5 depot
6 riverside town | 7 radio hill | 8 lighthouse | 9 dismount | 10 sawmill | 11 water tower
Dense woods: foot off-road, vehicles on declared roads. Water: declared crossings only.
Contours: synthetic 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 m. Roads and markers are schematic; structure footprints use meters.
Planning geometry only. No support surfaces, traffic, sensing, occupancy, supply or destruction implementation.
